name: Kyouso-sama no Yabou ~Teito Cosplay-ka Keikaku~
original_name: 教祖様の野望 ～帝都コスプレ化計画～
source:
Shogo Jindai is a true otaku, and one day he's visited by the EroGoddess herself and entrusted with a holy mission...

[Edited from a [url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=4108]forum post[/url] by Baldo]
